title: Degree bound for circuit polynomials
statement: Let $C$ be an algebraic circuit on $n$ inputs, with size equal to its number of gates. The total degree of the polynomial computed by $C$ over $\mathbb{Z}$ is at most $2^{\mathrm{size}(C)}$.
